en.headline: HKMA flags about 400 cases of unauthorised contactless payment-card binding
en.dek: Fraudsters use phishing messages, fake sites or calls to obtain card details and PINs, then coax victims into approving binding requests so they can make unauthorised transactions.
body: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said on Friday that major retail banks had recently reported about 400 cases in which payment cards, including ATM cards, were bound without authorisation to contactless mobile payment services. The authority has shared the modus operandi with the industry and reminded banks to heighten vigilance and strengthen customer education.

In the reported cases, fraudsters impersonated merchants or other organisations through phishing messages, fraudulent websites or phone calls. They used pretexts such as offering compensation for goods to obtain payment-card details and ATM personal identification numbers. Victims were then persuaded to approve binding requests via mobile banking apps or two-way SMS, after which the fraudsters could carry out unauthorised transactions.

The HKMA reminded the public that binding a payment card is a high-risk operation. People should never click hyperlinks in messages from unknown sources, never disclose card details, PINs, login passwords or one-time passwords, and never follow instructions from unverified persons to approve binding requests. Anyone who suspects they have been targeted should contact their bank and the police immediately.

zh.headline: 金管局：近期約400宗支付卡被綁定非接觸式流動支付騙案
zh.dek: 騙徒以釣魚訊息、假網站或電話誘騙取得卡資料及密碼，再誘使受害人批准綁定以便進行未經授權交易。
body: 金管局周五表示，主要零售銀行近期共發現約400宗涉及支付卡（包括自動櫃員機提款卡）被未經授權綁定至非接觸式流動支付服務的騙案。該局已與銀行業界分享行騙手法，提醒銀行提高警覺並加強客戶教育。
個案中，騙徒透過釣魚訊息、虛假網站或電話，冒充商戶或其他機構，以不同藉口（例如就貨品作出賠償）誘騙受害人提供支付卡資料及自動櫃員機私人密碼，再誘使受害人透過手機銀行應用程式或雙向簡訊批准綁定請求。支付卡一經綁定，騙徒便可進行未經授權交易。
金管局提醒市民，綁定支付卡屬高風險操作，切勿點擊來歷不明訊息中的超連結，切勿向任何人透露卡資料、私人密碼、登入密碼或一次性密碼，亦不要聽從不明或未經核實人士的指示批准綁定請求。如懷疑受騙，應立即聯絡銀行及報警。
